text: You run the ISO desk at a funder.
Dozens of broker shops, all sending deals.
And every one of them needs a follow-up.
Sticky notes. Missed calls. A CRM nobody likes.
ISO Desk fixes that. Your shops, your deals and your follow-ups, on one simple screen.
Every morning, Today shows exactly who to call, and why.
Set a follow-up in a couple of taps. Pick the shop, pick when, say what it's for, and you're done.
When it's due, it pings your phone, even with the desk closed.
Call from your phone, right from the alert. When you hang up, log what happened, and the next step, all in one box.
Deals move from submission to funded, and it stops you when a bank statement's missing.
It even tells you when another shop already sent you the same merchant.
ISO Desk. Built for ISO managers. Simple enough to use every day.
Want it for your team? Call or text two two four, six one nine, six eight seven six.
